 Everything New on Streaming in November: Netflix, HBO Max and More
 Here’s where you’ll find your holiday favorites and more
 Andi Ortiz 
 November 1, 2026 @ 10:00 AM 
 Share on Social Media
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X (formerly Twitter) 
 Share on LinkedIn 
 Share on Email 
 Jessica Chastain in "Heartland" (Netflix) 
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready… 
 Watch out, we’re pretty much at the end of the year. It seems impossible, I know, but we’re into November now, and that means another streaming shake-up.
 At this point, you’re probably starting to think about where you’ll be able to find your holiday season favorites, and that’s a good thought, because there are a lot of them. And of course, they’re pretty spread out. But, as always, we’ve got an eye on the streaming catalogues for you, and have compiled them into one big, easy-to-find list.
 Here’s everything new on streaming services in November 2026.
